avis.titre: My go-to essence for irritated skin
avis.texte: I've used this essence on-and-off for years and keep coming back, especially when my skin is irritated or damaged. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a super simple, hydrating essence that will not irritate sensitive or acne-prone skin. If you are looking for anything other than just hydration, I would skip. Description: The essence is unscented, and little bit thicker than a typical starting essence, but still lightweight; I would consider it medium weight, sitting somewhere between an essence and toner. The texture is somewhat slick, pats/rubs in easily and drys down relatively quickly but can still be felt on the skin after application. Ingredients: It only contains 7 ingredients, with Astragalus Membranaceous root water being the star of the show. Astragalus is an herb often used in traditional Chinese medicine and purportedly has anti-inflammatory effects, but research is still limited. This is what seems to make it effective for sensitive (rosacea, eczema, seb derm, etc.) and acne-prone skin. The remainder of the ingredients are aimed at hydration and include humectants, thickening agents, and an amino acid (argine). Argine technically provides antioxidant and collagen-boosting benefits, but it's listed as the last ingredient so I would not purchase this product based on those benefits. avis.titre: An Everyday Essential for Dry SkinAn Everyday Essential for Dry Skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Pyunkang Yul Essence Toner for years now, and it’s one of the very few skincare products I consistently repurchase. I have dry, uneven skin that gets irritated easily, and this toner has been a staple for keeping my skin balanced and comfortable. The texture is thicker than a typical toner—more like a light essence—but it absorbs beautifully and provides deep hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. I love that it has minimal ingredients and focuses on hydration rather than unnecessary additives. It’s never caused irritation, breakouts, or stinging, even when my skin barrier is compromised. I use it after my regular toner and before my serum, and it really helps my serum soak in better and feel more effective. With regular use, my skin feels softer, more hydrated, and looks more even overall. I also like layering it when my skin is extra dry, and it works perfectly under moisturizers both morning and night. If you have dry or sensitive skin and want something simple, effective, and reliable, this essence toner truly lives up to its reputation. It’s gentle, no-frills Korean skincare that actually works.

avis.titre: Non-irritating, Light+Layer-able, Fast Absorption, Slight Brightening
avis.texte: I decided to give the Essence Toner a shot as I've heard only positive things about the toner. I have dry to normal skin for reference, and if followed up by a moisturizing essence, serum and moisturizer, the Pyunkang Yul Essence Toner is a great toner. [ PROS ] - Non-irritating, great for sensitive skin, also calming and cooling - Very, very light fragrance to none at all so those are sensitive to fragrances would most likely be fine - Definitely absorbs quickly, great for if you're in a rush - What was nice is how light and layerable the product is, definitely a great product to do the 7 skin method (although I do not use only toner; serum and a moisturizer are necessary for me. If you are looking to do only the 7 skin method and your skin isn't too dry, the Essence Toner may work for you. However, if your skin is on the dryer side, I would suggest using at least a moisturizer following your layers) - One added little bonus I saw after cleansing/washing my face at night is that using this toner brightened my complexion a bit. I've watched how this is for a week and I would have to say that over time this Essence Toner will help to brighten your complexion. This does not mean it will significantly and immediately brighten your skin, like I said, it is subtle but is definitely noticeable if used for longer than a week [ CONS ] - None really. The only thing is, based on each person's skin type, using this alone for the 7 skin method will most likely not be moisturizing enough.

I really love this toner! It leaves my skin feeling deeply hydrated and refreshed after every use. My face feels much smoother, sifter and looks radiant. It absorbs well without feeling sticky. It has become an essential part of my skincare routine. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a hydrating toner.

I absolutely LOVE this product! For skin over 40, it’s everything I was looking for. The lightweight gel texture feels amazing. it’s never heavy or greasy. It gives my skin the most beautiful healthy glow while keeping it hydrated. My skin feels fresh, smooth, and radiant every time I use it. I would buy this a thousand times over!

This product saves my dry, sensitive skin over and over. Its deeply hydrating. It keeps my barrier in the best condition possible and if it gets damaged it helps to quickly repair it. As someone with dry skin it's very easy for the barrier to become damaged. I use this twice a day and my skin looks and feels great. I like to massage it in and then pat it to make sure it's really sunk in.

So hydrating not sticky at all. Minimal ingredient list. Great for irritated or sensitive skin. I would recommend for all skin types. It is a bit heavier than some hydrating toners but it sinks in quickly. Have repurchased a few times.

avis.titre: Solid toner; does not trigger my acne or my seb derm!
avis.texte: I've got scalp seborrheic dermatitis. I also have scalp psoriasis, and I'm acne prone. I also have allergies, and fragrance REALLY bothers me. Why am I telling you this? Basically, this means I have to spend hours researching products to make sure the ingredients are safe for my skin before I can use them. This product has a short ingredient list. Although my sebopsoriasis is only on my scalp, I make sure my skincare products are safe before it's so easy to accidentally get products on my hair line. These pictures are about 2-3 weeks apart. I knew my skin was dehydrated. The texture on my skin is a lot more noticeable in picture 1. I used an Asian skincare routine for years, but I could no longer afford all those products. I use the Vanicream gel cleanser, Cerave hydrating toner (it has hyaluronic acid), and Vanicream moisturizing cream in the tub. I got this product on sale. Any fragrance in this product is minimal. You can layer it. It doesn't leave me feeling sticky or slimy like other toners. I use 2 layers if I'm feeling dry. It doesn't trigger my acne; any acne you see is hormonal. TL;DR - Appears to be safe for several skin conditions. Do your own research and patch test, but I think it's worth the hype!

avis.titre: Few ingredients but might not be potent enough
avis.texte: I saw this toner come up a few times on TikTok when I was looking for a K-Beauty hydrating toner. The claims all stated that it was amazing for barrier repair and super hydrating and moisturizing. My skin is combo dry and with the climate being really dry and cold right now from it being winter, I figured it would be perfect. Post cleansing, the first time I tried it I applied a pretty generous layer all over my face and my skin absorbed it all immediately. After about a minute I noticed my skin was starting to feel really tight, so I added another layer and still had that tight and kind of dry feeling all over. I looked online and found some users saying to apply several layers so it had time to sink into the skin in between layers and be able to hydrate all over. I also saw some people say to apply while the skin was still damp. I tried all these different methods every night for about 7-10 days and unfortunately didn’t see any positive effects in my skin. It didn’t feel any more hydrated, or less dry really. I use a gentle cleanser and a good moisturizer, so I know I wasn’t using anything too harsh beforehand; or anything that didn’t moisturize enough after. I initially did a patch test on the back of my hand before trying it on my face and it did make that patch of skin really soft afterwards. I think this product could be great for someone with normal to slightly dry skin. I just don’t think it is potent enough to help if you have really dry or dehydrated skin.

This stuff is amazing, it's very simple ingredients but such good quality and so effective with holding water in my skin. It's kinda thick, but I don't mind it. It's not sticky at all. avis.titre: A must have in a routine for dry skin!
avis.texte: I have extremely dry, sensitive skin and rosacea, plus I’m 36 - so I really need all the moisture I can get. I use this “toner”, as a hydration step in my AM and PM skincare routines and I simply couldn’t live without it. After using a gentle cleanser (or double cleansing at night), I pour a little of this into the palm of my hand, rub them together, and gently press this product into my damp skin to really lock in that hydration. The texture of this is like thick, silky water, and while I think this product is fragrance free, it has an extremely mild, but pleasant scent that is barely noticeable. This is like a drink of water for your skin. It makes my skin bouncy and plump, and it plays well with other products. It’s not heavy on the skin at all, so you can go straight into the next steps of your routine with your skin still damp from this toner essence and get the maximum benefits and hydration. I’ve been using it for years and haven’t found something I enjoy more!

I purchased this from Amazon and was enjoying it very much. It isn't quite as viscous or as fragrant as some Korean toners (Whamisa) but it has more body than the very watery ones (like Huxley or the Face Shop). I liked using it as part of the 7 skin method so much that I came back to purchase another bottle. But then I read the reviews about the fakes and the warnings that the authentic bottles should have labels showing 3.7 oz rather than 3.8 oz which is what I received. So, worried that my bottle was a fake, I ordered a bottle from a lovely authorized seller (Ohlolly). I received it today and guess what, the new labels on authentic bottles *do* show 3.8 oz. I opened the bottle and the two toners looked, felt and smelled exactly the same to me. I think both bottles, the one purchased here through KBS and the one purchased directly at Ohlolly are authentic. I suspect the label has simply changed (the back labels which show instructions and ingredients are also identical and are in both English and Korean). In my photo the bottle on the left came through Amazon and the one on the right from the authorized seller.

avis.titre: Deep Mega Hydration. Manufacturer Sealed, Both Sides, Top&Bottom
avis.texte: Will be an absolutely amazing addition to my skincare! And a lightweight moisturizer in the dry & crazy 110% Arizona weather! K Beauty & J Beauty are way ahead of us, has saved my skin! When my skin barrier is compromised/ sensitive, I don't want to become allergic to skincare ingredients like Peptides, Bakuchiol, or any other helpful ingredients because my skin is sensitive and overreactive! It happens to a lot of people, whether on Tretinoin or too much AHA/BHA, and I don't want to be that person! So many Educating Dermatologists recommended this on YouTube! So excited. I really needed an effective hydrator with *simple* ingredients when my skin barrier is compromised.

The bottle is not as big as I thought it would be but it’s still an amazing product. It’s moisturizing, not exfoliating so it’s perfect for the 7 skins method(putting toner on 7 times). I’ve been using this product for about a week and I have seen a change in my skin. The texture is like a thick water. My skin is smoother and it looks more dewy and healthier. I would look at myself in the mirror and turn my face, I would see a really nice glow that I don’t think I had before. I put this toner on between every skin care step that comes after exfoliating or cleansing. It’s probably a few of many many products that I’ve tried that I will be purchasing again. This is the first time I’ve written a review btw. This product absorbs into the skin quickly and it’s like water straight to ur skin. Highly recommend!

After using this product for ~2.5 months I give it an overall 5 stars. I use it twice daily after cleansing (3 dime sized pats over my face down to my neck). The packaging was beautiful in a blue box sealed (my picture shows after opening). The bottle itself is blue I assume to better preserve it. I love the ingredients list since I’m a big fan of natural medicinal products. I have sensitive dry skin. When I put the product on my face it was incredibly soothing and like I put medicine on my face. I loved the very slight root scent (disappears quickly). It is slightly viscous but in a good way if you like layering products. I wait until it drys completely to move onto layering another product on. So far my skin loves it and after trying a new product that doesn’t work with my skin this all I’ll use after cleansing (+sunscreen) to help repair my skin and get it stronger again. Definitely rebuying this when I’ve emptied my first bottle.
